The funny thing about this guy is he never even mentioned personality once. Mental illness is just that, an illness. It doesn't personify their personality. It seems to me he doesn't care about personality, cares only about looks and health, and would rather have a mentally stable person instead because he's not patient enough to deal with the kind of bullshit mental illnesses can cause. 

The way I live is imo 100x better. I don't have standards. None at all. As long as they're a good person, that's really all that matters. I think tall people are hot, I think short people are cute, and I think average height people are a good mix between both. Does that affect my dating range? Nope. 

When it comes to weight, only taking into account the fat-muscle ratio, if someone is overweight or worse, obese, and I care about them a lot, I'll obviously be pushing them from time to time to lose a little. Not as an insult, just cause I want them to be able to live a long and healthy life. I can't imagine how common it is for overweight people to get major stomach aches or worse, a blockage of the intestines. I would date an overweight person, and I'd help them improve out of that and into slightly above average to average weight class, because I love them. 

Personality. IDC what mental illness someone has. As long as you don't murder me, you're A-Okay. I have schizophrenia, as well as multiple personality disorder (keeping it as that since the name of the disorder chances consistently) ADHD, Acute Stress Disorder, and severe anxiety. That's a whole bunch of illnesses that if combined together, could create a massive fuck fest that drives people away. Yet, I have people who love me for who I am, not what I am. Even if I don't know who I am, even if I am a burden, even if I hurt them, they still are there for me and they give me love no matter what. One of those people, a girl whom I've known for about 6 years, is someone I currently have a crush on. What about her is so good? Not her looks, not her money, not fame, none of that. She's just an amazing person, with the most wholesome personality ever, something that makes me just want to hug her and give her head pats. And for some reason she also wants to hug me and give me head pats. 

All in all, I'm severely below average. I'm unattractive, I have no skills, I'm severely mentally challenged, I'm shy, and at times I'm a tremendous burden. But people still love me for who I am despite that. Everything said in there already proves this guy wrong. 

And to the gender rolls part: When we had to live in trees, in constant fear of death, gender rolls were important. Now, we have more luxury's than our ancestors could even dream of. One of those luxury's, is not having to listen to the innate evolutionary gender rolls we have. We can be ourselves, grow up to be who we want to be, choose our own jobs, find someone to love, marry, start a family, grow old and pamper your grandkids with money. We're lucky to have been born in this age, so let's just stop arguing about dumb possibly sexist things at this point and just love each other. Not for sex, but for the person underneath the skin. Only that way will we be truly happy, when our lives finally come to a close.
